translation: Flavor bitter, warm, non-toxic. It governs evil-qi (邪氣), damp-bi (濕痹), cold and heat (寒熱), carbuncle sores (疽瘡), removes water and hard accumulations (水堅積), blood masses (血症), amenorrhea (月閉), no child (無子), children unable to walk (小不能行), the various malignant sores (諸惡瘡), carbuncle swelling, stops abdominal pain (止腹痛), and makes women have children (令女人有子). One name is 炭 (tàn)...
